acceptance: cmd_stage.go and cmd_stage_chain.go read the decision version from one function, so the two verbs cannot derive it differently.
computeRecordHash hashes an explicit hashedRecord type, and a test fails when a Record field is added without a decision on whether it is hashed.
fix: Give the DecisionVersion derivation of a registry entry one home in stageevidence, called by both verbs. Restore an explicit hashed-record schema for the evidence hash.
source: architecture review of the K2 rebuild (PR #1690 r3), 2026-11-23
summary: The architecture seat on the K2 rebuild found two MEDIUM issues that do not block after round 2: cmd_stage.go:84 and cmd_stage_chain.go:67 both compute stageevidence.DecisionVersion with the same arguments, and score.go:168 now hashes the whole Record with Hash cleared, so any new Record field silently changes the hash schema.
title: The stage-evidence decision version and hash schema each have one explicit home
